snippet.title: Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Ragnarök has begun. Take up arms as Thrud, daughter of Thor, in Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök, a fast-paced Bullet Heaven action roguelite inspired by Norse mythology.

Face relentless hordes as you combine weapons, rune abilities and divine blessings into increasingly powerful builds. Complete quests during each run to earn the favor and powers of Odin, Thor and other gods, while precise movement, positioning and tactical decisions keep you alive against the forces of Ragnarök.

Fight through handcrafted levels inspired by Norse mythology, unlock new abilities and weapons across multiple runs and grow powerful enough to free the imprisoned gods and stop Loki's plans.

Wishlist Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214330/Valkyrie_Rising_Hordes_of_Ragnark/

Coming to Steam in Q4 2026.

Play Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök at gamescom 2026 in Hall 10.2, Booth E051g.

#GamingUp #GamingUpShowcase #ValkyrieRising #Roguelite #BulletHeaven #gamescom2026
